Browser Isolation Resource Get Cloud Browser Isolation Profiles
GET
https://api.zsapi.net/zia/api/v1/browserIsolation/profiles

Gets a list of all the cloud browser isolation profiles in the Isolation Profile field for URL Filtering Policy and Cloud App Control Policy rules.

Responses
​
200

Successful Operation

APPLICATION/JSON
Schema
Example (auto)
SCHEMA
Array [
id
string

The universally unique identifier (UUID) for the browser isolation profile

name
string

Name of the browser isolation profile

url
string

The browser isolation profile URL

defaultProfile
boolean

(Optional) Indicates whether this is a default browser isolation profile. Zscaler sets this field.

]
